description: Short verification prompts for constrained local Ollama benchmarking.

prompts.prompt:
You are helping with an authorized local project. Explain this Python error and give the smallest safe fix:

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "app.py", line 14, in <module>
    print(total / count)
ZeroDivisionError: division by zero

Answer with cause, fix, and one tiny code snippet.

For an authorized defensive lab, interpret this Nmap result and list safe next steps only:

22/tcp open ssh OpenSSH 9.6
80/tcp open http nginx 1.24
443/tcp open https nginx 1.24

Keep it defensive and concise.

Summarize these networking notes into revision bullets:

DNS maps names to IP addresses. DHCP leases IP settings to clients. NAT lets private hosts share one public IP. Firewalls filter traffic based on policy.

Include one possible exam question.

Review this backtest note for research only, not live trading advice:

GBPUSD strategy: 120 trades, profit factor 1.18, max drawdown 8.5%, average R 0.12, strongest month +4.1%, weakest month -3.7%.

Separate factual observations from cautions.
